title: The table that wouldn't stop rocking
_story: Steve's table rocks every time he puts his cake down. Ismaeel sees how a table is made, finds the bump under one leg, then discovers that a 3-legged table never rocks: 3 feet always touch. So why do most tables have 4?
_stepChain: a rocking table → made like a chair: top, legs, apron → floors aren't flat: a bump → why does it rock? → 3 legs on the same bump: steady → 3 points always touch (tripod) → so why 4? harder to tip → fixing a wobble

talk.ask: Why does a 3-legged table never rock?
talk.goodAnswer: 3 feet can always all touch the floor at once, even on a bump; a 4th leg can be left hanging in the air.

talk.ask: Then why do most tables have 4 legs?
talk.goodAnswer: 4 legs make it harder to tip over when you lean on an edge, and they fit neatly at the corners.

handsOn: Find a table or chair at home that wobbles. Which leg lifts off the floor? Fold a piece of card and slide it under that leg. Did it stop?

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: Every time I put my cake on this table, it rocks! Tip, tap, tip, tap. What's wrong with it?
A table is made like a chair. Wood from a log is dried, then cut into a top, 4 legs and 4 rails. Under a table, the rails are called the apron. Joints and glue lock them together.
But floors are never perfectly flat. Here, one leg is standing on a tiny bump.

choices: One leg is on a bump, so only 3 legs touch at a time
question.onRight: Yes. With one leg on a bump, only 3 legs can touch at once. It rocks between them.

1.mistake: blames weight instead of the floor
1.hint: Count the legs touching the floor while it rocks.
1.say: A heavy table would sit still. It rocks because one leg is on a bump, so only 3 legs touch at a time, and it tips between them.

2.hint: Are the joints loose, or is it the floor?
2.say: The joints are tight. The table rocks because the floor has a bump: only 3 legs can touch at once.

question.reveal: Only 3 legs can touch at once, so it rocks.

narration.text: Now here's a round table with 3 legs, on the same bumpy floor.

question.onRight: Yes, you predicted it. It tilts a tiny bit, but it doesn't rock.

0.mistake: thinks a bump always makes a table rock
0.hint: How many legs does it have to touch the floor with? Can they all touch?
0.say: Watch: it tilts a tiny bit, but all 3 feet still touch the floor. So it doesn't rock.

question.reveal: It stands still: all 3 feet touch.

narration.text: 3 feet can always all touch the ground at once, even on a bumpy floor. That's why a camera stand has 3 legs. It's called a tripod.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: So why does my table have 4 legs, if 3 never rock?

question.prompt: Why do most tables have 4 legs?
choices: 4 legs are harder to tip over
question.onRight: Yes. Lean on the edge of a 3-legged table, between two legs, and it tips. 4 legs at the corners hold it steady.

1.mistake: thinks more legs means less wood
1.hint: Count the legs: which needs more wood, 3 or 4?
1.say: 4 legs need more wood, not less. The reason is safety: 4 legs at the corners make a table much harder to tip over.

2.mistake: guesses at a reason that isn't about balance
2.hint: Think about leaning on the edge of the table.
2.say: Legs don't make noise. 4 legs make a table harder to tip over when you lean on an edge.

question.reveal: 4 legs are harder to tip over.

narration.text: So how do people stop a 4-legged table rocking? Some tables have little feet that screw up and down, so each leg can be made the right length. Or you can fold a piece of card under the short leg.

rule.text: 3 feet always touch. 4 legs are harder to tip, but can rock.
rule.ask: Can you say why tables rock? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: 3 legs always touch the floor, so they never rock. 4 legs are harder to tip over, but on a bump they can rock.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: a camera tripod has 3 legs. How many legs do 4 tripods have?

0.hint: Each tripod has its own 3 legs. Count 3 at a time.
0.say: You added 4 and 3. Count 3 for each tripod: 3, 6, 9, 12.

2.hint: Count the tripods again: there are 4.
